item.title: 1. _torh_compare.py
item.author: CH-Tiger
item.description:
1. _torh_compare.py
"""Fallback per-tensor comparison used by run_msprobe_compare.sh.

  

Pairs tensors by their recorded name (which encodes side_layer_idx_submodule_kind)

and reports max_abs_diff / mean_abs_diff / cosine per pair, plus the first layer

where divergence exceeds a threshold. This mirrors what msprobe produces so the

report is useful even when the official tool isn't installed.

"""

import argparse

import json

from pathlib import Path

  

import torch

  
  

def cosine(a, b):

    fa = a.flatten().float()

    fb = b.flatten().float()

    denom = fa.norm() * fb.norm()

    if denom == 0:

        return 1.0

    return (fa @ fb / denom).item()

  
  

def main():

    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()

    ap.add_argument("--h20", required=True)

    ap.add_argument("--npu", required=True)

    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)

    ap.add_argument("--threshold", type=float, default=0.01,

                    help="max_abs_diff above this marks a pair as DIVERGED")

    args = ap.parse_args()

  

    h_idx = json.loads((Path(args.h20) / "index.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    n_idx = json.loads((Path(args.npu) / "index.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

  

    # Names differ only by side prefix; normalize by stripping "h20_"/"npu_".

    def norm(name): return name.split("_", 1)[1]

    h_map = {norm(k): k for k in h_idx}

    n_map = {norm(k): k for k in n_idx}

    common = sorted(set(h_map) & set(n_map))

  

    rows = []

    first_diverged = None

    for key in common:

        h_path = Path(args.h20) / h_idx[h_map[key)

        n_path = Path(args.npu) / n_idx[n_map[key)

        if not h_path.exists() or not n_path.exists():

            continue

        a = torch.load(str(h_path), map_location="cpu")

        b = torch.load(str(n_path), map_location="cpu")

        if torch.is_tensor(a) and torch.is_tensor(b):

            if a.shape != b.shape:

                rows.append({"name": key, "status": "SHAPE_MISMATCH",

                             "shape_a": list(a.shape), "shape_b": list(b.shape)})

                continue

            diff = (a.float() - b.float()).abs()

            mad = diff.max().item()

            mean = diff.mean().item()

            cos = cosine(a, b)

            status = "DIVERGED" if mad > args.threshold else "ok"

            if status == "DIVERGED" and first_diverged is None:

                first_diverged = key

            rows.append({"name": key, "max_abs_diff": mad,

                         "mean_abs_diff": mean, "cosine": round(cos, 6),

                         "status": status})

  

    rows.sort(key=lambda r: -r.get("max_abs_diff", 0))

    print(f"\n{'name':<40}{'max_diff':>12}{'mean_diff':>12}{'cosine':>10}  status")

    print("-" * 78)

    for r in rows[:30]:

        if r["status"] == "SHAPE_MISMATCH":

            print(f"{r['name']:<40}{'-':>12}{'-':>12}{'-':>10}  SHAPE_MISMATCH")

        else:

            print(f"{r['name']:<40}{r['max_abs_diff']:>12.6f}"

                  f"{r['mean_abs_diff']:>12.6f}{r['cosine']:>10.4f}  {r['status']}")

  

    n_div = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("status") == "DIVERGED")

    print(f"\n{len(rows)} pairs, {n_div} DIVERGED (threshold {args.threshold})")

    if first_diverged:

        print(f"first diverged tensor: {first_diverged}")

    Path(args.out).write_text(

        json.dumps({"rows": rows, "n_diverged": n_div,

                    "first_diverged": first_diverged}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),

        encoding="utf-8")

    print(f"report written to {args.out}")

  
  

if __name__ == "__main__":

    main()

item.title: 测试 1-gen_outputs.py
item.author: CH-Tiger
item.description:
"""Generate outputs from an SGLang server for cross-hardware precision comparison.

  

Compatible with both the native /generate endpoint and the OpenAI-compatible

/v1/completions endpoint (used by some NPU setups). Determinism is enforced via

temperature=0; pass --seed to also pin server-side RNG.

  

Usage:

    # Native SGLang endpoint (default)

    python gen_outputs.py --base-url http://localhost:30000 --output outputs.jsonl

  

    # OpenAI-compatible endpoint

    python gen_outputs.py --base-url http://npu-host:30000 --api openai \

        --model-name Qwen3.5-Flash --output outputs.jsonl

  

    # Optional: encode token ids locally if the server doesn't return them

    python gen_outputs.py --base-url ... --tokenizer /data/models/Qwen/Qwen3.5-Flash

"""

import argparse

import json

import os

import sys

import time

  

import requests

  
  

def generate_native(base_url: str, text: str, max_new_tokens: int, seed: int):

    """Call SGLang native /generate endpoint."""

    resp = requests.post(

        f"{base_url}/generate",

        json={

            "text": text,

            "sampling_params": {

                "max_new_tokens": max_new_tokens,

                "temperature": 0,   # greedy, deterministic

                "top_p": 1.0,

                "top_k": -1,

            },

            "stream": False,

        },

        timeout=300,

    )

    resp.raise_for_status()

    out = resp.json()

    return out.get("text", ""), out.get("output_ids", [])

  
  

def generate_openai(base_url: str, text: str, model_name: str,

                    max_new_tokens: int, seed: int):

    """Call OpenAI-compatible /v1/completions endpoint."""

    resp = requests.post(

        f"{base_url}/v1/completions",

        json={

            "model": model_name,

            "prompt": text,

            "max_tokens": max_new_tokens,

            "temperature": 0,

            "top_p": 1.0,

            "seed": seed,

        },

        timeout=300,

    )

    resp.raise_for_status()

    out = resp.json()

    choice = out["choices"][0]

    text_out = choice.get("text", "")

    # Try to get token ids from logprobs; fall back later if absent.

    ids = []

    logprobs = choice.get("logprobs")

    if logprobs and "token_ids" in logprobs:

        ids = list(logprobs["token_ids"])

    return text_out, ids

  
  

def wait_for_server(base_url: str, timeout: int = 600):

    """Block until the server /health responds."""

    deadline = time.time() + timeout

    last_err = None

    while time.time() < deadline:

        try:

            r = requests.get(f"{base_url}/health", timeout=5)

            if r.status_code == 200:

                return

        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001

            last_err = e

        time.sleep(5)

    raise RuntimeError(f"server at {base_url} not ready within {timeout}s: {last_err}")

  
  

def main():

    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()

    ap.add_argument("--base-url", default="http://localhost:30000")

    ap.add_argument("--api", choices=["native", "openai"], default="native")

    ap.add_argument("--model-name", default="default",

                    help="model name for OpenAI-compatible API")

    ap.add_argument("--prompts", default="prompts.jsonl")

    ap.add_argument("--output", required=True)

    ap.add_argument("--max-new-tokens", type=int, default=256)

    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)

    ap.add_argument("--tokenizer", default=None,

                    help="HF model path; if set, re-encode output text to get "

                         "token ids when the server omits them")

    ap.add_argument("--no-wait", action="store_true",

                    help="skip server health check")

    args = ap.parse_args()

  

    if not args.no_wait:

        print(f"waiting for server at {args.base_url} ...", flush=True)

        wait_for_server(args.base_url)

  

    tokenizer = None

    if args.tokenizer:

        from transformers import AutoTokenizer

        tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(

            args.tokenizer, trust_remote_code=True)

  

    with open(args.prompts, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:

        prompts = [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]

  

    results = []

    for i, p in enumerate(prompts):

        if args.api == "native":

            text_out, ids = generate_native(

                args.base_url, p["text"], args.max_new_tokens, args.seed)

        else:

            text_out, ids = generate_openai(

                args.base_url, p["text"], args.model_name,

                args.max_new_tokens, args.seed)

  

        if not ids and tokenizer is not None:

            ids = tokenizer.encode(text_out, add_special_tokens=False)

  

        results.append({

            "id": i,

            "prompt": p["text"],

            "output_text": text_out,

            "output_ids": list(ids),

        })

        print(f"[{i+1}/{len(prompts)}] tokens={len(ids)}", flush=True)

  

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(args.output)), exist_ok=True)

    with open(args.output, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:

        for r in results:

            f.write(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    print(f"saved {len(results)} outputs to {args.output}", flush=True)

  
  

if __name__ == "__main__":

    sys.exit(main())

item.title: 测试 2-compare_outputs.py
item.author: CH-Tiger
item.description:
"""Compare two output files produced by gen_outputs.py.

  

Reports token-level match rate and text-level similarity, then writes a JSON

report with per-sample stats and the worst-diverging prompts.

"""

import argparse

import difflib

import json

import statistics

  
  

def load(path):

    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:

        return [json.loads(l) for l in f if l.strip()]

  
  

def token_match_rate(ids_a, ids_b):

    n = min(len(ids_a), len(ids_b))

    if n == 0:

        return 0.0, 0

    hit = sum(1 for i in range(n) if ids_a[i] == ids_b[i])

    return hit / n, n

  
  

def text_similarity(a, b):

    return difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a, b).ratio()

  
  

def main():

    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()

    ap.add_argument("--baseline", required=True)

    ap.add_argument("--target", required=True)

    ap.add_argument("--out", default="compare_report.json")

    args = ap.parse_args()

  

    base = load(args.baseline)

    tgt = load(args.target)

    assert len(base) == len(tgt), f"count mismatch: {len(base)} vs {len(tgt)}"

  

    rows = []

    for a, b in zip(base, tgt):

        assert a["id"] == b["id"], f"id mismatch: {a['id']} vs {b['id']}"

        tm, n = token_match_rate(a["output_ids"], b["output_ids"])

        ts = text_similarity(a["output_text"], b["output_text"])

        rows.append({

            "id": a["id"],

            "len_base": len(a["output_ids"]),

            "len_target": len(b["output_ids"]),

            "token_match_rate": round(tm, 4),

            "text_similarity": round(ts, 4),

        })

  

    avg_tm = statistics.mean(r["token_match_rate"] for r in rows)

    avg_ts = statistics.mean(r["text_similarity"] for r in rows)

    len_base = statistics.mean(r["len_base"] for r in rows)

    len_target = statistics.mean(r["len_target"] for r in rows)

    len_ratio = len_target / len_base if len_base else 0.0

  

    print(f"\n=== Summary ({len(rows)} samples) ===")

    print(f"avg token match rate : {avg_tm:.4f}")

    print(f"avg text similarity  : {avg_ts:.4f}")

    print(f"avg len baseline     : {len_base:.1f}")

    print(f"avg len target       : {len_target:.1f}  (ratio {len_ratio:.3f})")

  

    worst = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: r["text_similarity"])[:5]

    print("\nworst 5 samples:")

    for r in worst:

        print(f"  id={r['id']:>3}  tok_match={r['token_match_rate']:.3f}  "

              f"text_sim={r['text_similarity']:.3f}  "

              f"len {r['len_base']}->{r['len_target']}")

  

    # verdict per H20-vs-NPU experience thresholds

    ok_tm = avg_tm > 0.85

    ok_ts = avg_ts > 0.92

    ok_len = 0.9 <= len_ratio <= 1.1

    print("\n=== Verdict (H20 vs NPU thresholds) ===")

    print(f"  token match > 0.85 : {ok_tm}")

    print(f"  text sim    > 0.92 : {ok_ts}")

    print(f"  len ratio in [0.9,1.1] : {ok_len}")

    print(f"  overall: {'PASS -> proceed to lm_eval' if (ok_tm and ok_ts and ok_len) else 'FAIL -> run msprobe'}")

  

    with open(args.out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:

        json.dump({

            "summary": {

                "avg_token_match_rate": avg_tm,

                "avg_text_similarity": avg_ts,

                "avg_len_base": len_base,

                "avg_len_target": len_target,

                "len_ratio": len_ratio,

            },

            "rows": rows,

        }, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    print(f"\nreport written to {args.out}")

  
  

if __name__ == "__main__":

    main()
